context: Two managers run through a partner outreach checklist
purpose: Teach: 修士/勧誘/創刊/劣化/書士/ウェブログ/意味合い/度合い

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: では、パートナー候補のリストを見ながら、順番に確認していきましょうか。
lines.en: Alright, shall we go through the partner candidate list one by one?
lines.style: Polite businesslike tone opening a structured meeting

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうだね。まず最初は森本大学の研究室で、修士課程の学生たちにも声をかけたいらしい。
lines.en: Sure. First is the Morimoto University lab — they apparently want to reach out to master's program students too.
lines.style: Casual male manager sharing context with colleague calmly

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: なるほど。じゃあ向こうから勧誘のメールを送ってもらう前に、こちらで資料を整えておく必要がありますね。
lines.en: I see. Then we need to prepare materials before they send out the recruitment emails.
lines.style: Thoughtful planning voice from organized female manager

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: うん。それと、先方が新しい広報誌を創刊したから、そこに記事を載せてもらう話も進めたいんだ。
lines.en: Yeah. Also, they've launched a new PR magazine, so I want to push forward placing an article there.
lines.style: Steady male voice listing additional agenda points

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いいですね。ただ、前回いただいたサンプルは紙の劣化がかなり進んでいたので、データ入稿でお願いしましょう。
lines.en: Good idea. But last time's sample had significant paper degradation, so let's request digital submission.
lines.style: Practical female voice raising a quality concern politely

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 了解。あと、契約周りは知り合いの行政書士に一度相談しておくつもりだよ。
lines.en: Got it. And I'm planning to consult an acquaintance who's an administrative scrivener about the contract details.
lines.style: Reassuring male voice covering legal preparation

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 助かります。広報の方は、先方の個人ウェブログでも紹介してもらえると効果が大きいと思うんですが。
lines.en: That helps. For PR, I think it'd be very effective if they could also introduce us on their personal blog.
lines.style: Soft female voice proposing an extra channel diplomatically

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 確かに。ただ「協賛」と「提携」では意味合いがだいぶ違うから、文面はこちらで指定しておこう。
lines.en: True. But 'sponsorship' and 'partnership' carry quite different nuances, so let's specify the wording ourselves.
lines.style: Careful male voice flagging a subtle linguistic concern

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: では最後に、相手の本気度合いを見極めるために、来週の打ち合わせで具体的な数字を出してもらいましょう。
lines.en: Lastly, to gauge how serious they really are, let's have them present concrete numbers at next week's meeting.
lines.style: Firm closing remark from focused female manager

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 賛成。じゃあ僕は先方にアポを取って、君は資料の方をまとめておいてくれる?
lines.en: Agreed. Then I'll set up the appointment, and could you compile the materials on your side?
lines.style: Friendly male voice dividing tasks at meeting's end
